scope: Official TWD-universe web series. Wikipedia's franchise article says the franchise has 'eight web series that tie into the first two television series'; the Fandom navbox 'Webisode Episodes' lists the same eight. No official Ones Who Live / Daryl Dixon / Dead City web series were found in fetched sources.

series.title: The Walking Dead: Torn Apart
series.releasePlatform: AMC.com (all six parts released the same day)
series.placement: Before TWD S1E01: origin of the 'Bicycle Girl' walker Rick meets in 'Days Gone Bye'; set in King County, Georgia at the very start of the outbreak.

series.title: The Walking Dead: Red Machete
series.placement: Follows an object (Rick's red machete) across the whole apocalypse: starts before TWD S1 and continues to after TWD S8 (Fandom). Wikipedia: 'mainly through and after seasons 4, 5, 7, and 8'. Best watched after TWD S8.
series.notes: Per-part in-universe placement not stated by sources; series-level span only. Recommend watching the whole set after TWD S8.

series.title: The Althea Tapes
series.releasePlatform: AMC.com and The Walking Dead YouTube channel
series.placement: Mostly before Fear S4 (Althea's interviews before she meets Morgan); the final part is set between Fear S5 'Is Anybody Out There?' and 'Channel 4' (Fandom). Wikipedia: 'Set before the fourth season and before the second half of the fifth season'. Released to promote Fear S5B.

parts.title: Samora
parts.placementNote: Between Fear S5E08 'Is Anybody Out There?' and S5E09 'Channel 4' (per Fandom).

series.notes: The task brief guessed 2019-2020; sources show all six parts released 2019-07-27 to 2019-08-08. Per-part notes for parts 2-5 inferred from Fandom's series-level statement ('predominately prior to Season 4'); part 1 placement from its Fandom synopsis. Practical recommendation: watch the set between Fear S5E08 and S5E09 (Fandom chronological order places it there).

series.title: Fear the Walking Dead: Dead in the Water
series.placement: Aboard the submarine USS Pennsylvania on the eve of / as the apocalypse hits (Fear S1 period); serves as a prequel to Fear S6 story threads. Wikipedia: 'Set before the sixth season'. Released to promote Fear S7B.
